name: Kenneth Lynch & Sons
old_description: HANDCRAFTED FURNITURE FOR THE PENTHOUSE, VERANDA AND GARDEN SETTING
about:
Kenneth Lynch & Sons operates from Oxford, Connecticut, where the company has been producing handcrafted garden and estate furnishings for over ninety years. Founded by Kenneth Lynch and now in its third generation of family ownership, the business began as a workshop dedicated to classical European design traditions.

The firm manufactures three distinct product lines: Florentine Classics offers classically designed garden furniture handcrafted in metal and stone; Lynch Estate Elements supplies traditional garden ornament including statuary, planters, urns, sundials, and fountains; Lynch Urban Seating produces iconic benches and site furnishings installed in Central Park and other prominent parks nationwide. Production encompasses garden benches, park benches, estate furniture, game and picnic tables, and water features, all fabricated using traditional metalworking and stonecraft techniques.

The company serves the luxury residential market — penthouse terraces, verandas, and private gardens — as well as public institutions and landscape architects specifying site furnishings for parks and estates. Notable installations include benches in New York’s Central Park, with additional projects at fine parks and estates across the country.

Kenneth Lynch & Sons emphasizes continuity of craftsmanship, describing its work as “handcrafted in the European tradition” and highlighting a legacy of “fine craftsmanship” spanning three generations. The firm positions itself as a premier supplier of iconic, durable site furnishings for the most discerning outdoor environments.
